agent.busy: That is still running from before. Try again when it is done
agent.forbidden: You have no Grant at this Agent yet. Ask an Owner or whoever manages it.
agent.provider_unknown: That Provider or model isn't on this Machine
agent.unavailable: The Agent couldn't take this right now. Try again in a moment
agent.unknown: This Machine doesn't have that Agent
attachment.invalid: The file didn't match what the Agent sent, so it wasn't opened
attachment.missing: That file is no longer on the Machine
attachment.needs_direct: Files over 1 MB go only on a direct link to the Machine. Waiting for one: try again once the Machine page says direct.
attachment.open: The file is downloaded, but no app on this device can open it
attachment.timeout: The Machine didn't send the file in time. Try again
attachment.too_large: The file is over 20 MB, so the app cannot send it. Use git or a Connector instead
attachment.unavailable: This Machine can't send files yet
budget.exhausted: Today's Budget is used up. You can add Budget on the Agent's page
egress.forbidden: Only an Owner or someone with Manage at this Agent can change its Egress
egress.invalid_domain: The Machine kept its Egress: one entry isn't a plain domain name
egress.unavailable: The Machine couldn't save the Egress. Try again
file.needs_direct: Files over 1 MB open only on a direct link to the Machine. Waiting for one: try again once the Machine page says direct.
files.forbidden: Only an Owner can let an Agent read folders on the Machine.
files.has_triggers: This Agent still has {{count}} Trigger(s). An Agent that reaches past its own folder runs no Schedule, Watch or Idle Work: remove them first.
files.invalid: The file level or folders sent could not be read.
files.owner_only: This Agent reaches past its own folder, so it takes work from an Owner only.
files.wide_agent: This Agent reaches past its own folder, so it cannot have a Schedule, Watch or Idle Work. Use another Agent that keeps to its own folder.
folder.forbidden: This folder cannot be given: it is or holds the home folder, a place for secrets, browser data, the Runtime's own folder or a system folder.
folder.missing: There is no such folder on the Machine.
folder.not_a_folder: That path is a file, not a folder.
folder.not_absolute: Enter a full path starting with /.
folder.taken: {{agent}} already writes this folder. One Agent at a time may write a folder: make it read only here, or remove it from {{agent}} first.
git.forbidden: Only an Owner or someone with Manage at this Agent can change its repos
git.invalid_repo: A repo is not owner/name on GitHub, so nothing was saved
grant.forbidden: Only an Owner or someone with Manage at this Agent can grant here
grant.invalid: The level that was sent could not be read
grant.owner: An Owner already has Manage at every Agent, so needs no Grant
grant.unavailable: The Machine could not save the Grant. Try again.
grant.unknown_member: This Machine does not know that Member yet
hub.device_offline: Your other device isn't showing this QR code any more. Open Link new device on it again
hub.invitation_closed: This invitation is closed, full or expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
hub.invitation_invalid: The Hub did not take this invitation
hub.key_taken: The Hub refused the new device's key: it belongs to someone else, or was revoked before
hub.member_remove_invalid: Cannot remove this person. Only an Owner removes, and only someone who joined with an invitation link.
hub.last_device: The Hub refused: this would leave you no device that works. Link another device first
hub.link_invalid: The Hub refused the link because this device is not one of yours there
hub.link_request_invalid: The Hub refused this Linking request. Scan the QR code again
hub.machine_offline: That Machine is offline, so it did not get this
hub.machine_taken: That Machine already belongs to another Workspace. Run veeloe unpair on it, then pair again
hub.pairing_invalid: The Hub refused this link because the signatures did not check out or it has expired. Run veeloe pair again
hub.revocation_invalid: The Hub refused the revocation because it was not signed by one of your devices
hub.route_not_allowed: The Hub refused where this was going
hub.sender_mismatch: The Hub refused this because the sender did not match
invitation.link_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invitation.link_malformed: This is not a Veeloe invitation link, or part of it is missing
linking.expired: The QR code expired before linking finished. Make a new one on your other device
linking.link_expired: This link has expired. Make a new QR code on your other device
linking.link_malformed: That isn't a Linking link. Copy the whole link your other device shows
member.forbidden: Only an Owner can do this for now
pairing.hub_unreachable: Couldn't reach the Hub in this link. Check its address and your connection
pairing.link_bad_signature: This link was changed after the Machine made it, so it can't be used
pairing.link_expired: This link has expired. Run veeloe pair on the Machine again
pairing.link_malformed: That isn't a Pairing link. Copy the whole link veeloe pair shows
pairing.timed_out: The Machine didn't answer in time. Check veeloe pair is still running, then try again
provider.failed: The Provider answered with an error
provider.missing: The Agent's Provider was removed from the Machine. Pick a new one on the Agent's page
provider.rate_limited: The Provider's quota is used up; the Provider isn't down. Wait for it to come back, or top up with the Provider
provider.rejected: The Provider refused the key on the Machine
provider.unreachable: The Machine couldn't reach the Provider
task.not_found: This Machine doesn't have that Task
turn.not_running: This Task has no Turn running, so there is nothing to stop
turn.too_many_rounds: The Agent stopped after too many steps in one go
usage.invalid_range: That usage range isn't valid. It must be between 1 and 90 days
group.forbidden: Only an Owner makes a group or changes its name or admins, and only an Owner or a group admin changes who is in it
group.stale: Someone changed this group first; open it again and make the change once more
group.invalid: The Machine did not take this group
